nodes.objective:
Implement TASK-0093 acceptance criteria in
src/ahra/alignment_session.py and any needed helpers already granted
for this task. 1) draft_request runs the Acceptance Agent first,
reading only the frozen boundary contract; every Claim criterionRefs
entry must reference a boundary entry ID; capture the ClaimGraph
sha256 digest in the session snapshot before the Requirement Agent
is invoked. 2) The Requirement Agent payload includes the boundary
contract and the frozen ClaimGraph as read-only input; the accepted
RequestDraft ClaimGraph must be byte-identical to the frozen digest,
and any divergence rejects the draft as untrusted input. This guard
must detect present falsey values such as an empty claimGraph mapping
instead of treating them as absent. 3) A PlanDraft node claimRef that
does not resolve to a claim ID in the frozen ClaimGraph rejects the
draft with a structured error naming the unresolved refs. Cover all
three behaviors with tests in tests/test_alignment_session.py,
including the falsey-present claimGraph divergence case from
loop-001 review. Run uv run python -B scripts/check.py and record it
in WorkReport.verification_commands_run.

Verify acceptance-first serial drafting, ClaimGraph digest freeze, Requirement Agent ClaimGraph divergence rejection including falsey-present values, and claimRef resolution rejection are present and consistent.

spec.rationale:
Workflow A v2, step 2 of 3 (ADR-0010). Per work/tasks/TASK-0093/task.md:
draft_request must become acceptance-first serial - Acceptance Agent
drafts the ClaimGraph from the frozen boundary contract, the ClaimGraph
is digest-frozen, then the Requirement Agent drafts the PlanDraft with
read-only visibility of the frozen ClaimGraph. HEAD includes the
TASK-0092 boundary-contract baseline commit 73fd451. This loop-002 run
must also address the loop-001 semantic-review rejection: a Requirement
Agent claimGraph key that is present but falsey, including an empty
mapping, must still be validated and rejected when its digest diverges
from the frozen ClaimGraph.
